Clann na Ceo Gáire, or "The Mist-Laughing Clan," is a group formed from tragedy by seven individuals united in their quest for vengeance against the Roman Empire. Their bond, solidified by the Skull-Brand Oath, emphasizes chosen kinship and the duality of laughter and dread. Known for their guerrilla tactics, psychological warfare, and rich cultural rituals, they inspire rebellion among the oppressed. Chieftain Jester has chosen to ally with the Rantian Imperium, seeking to unite scattered Celtic clans.
